newsitem.title: GREECE: DELPHI FIXED INCOME FUND CLAIMS TOP 3-YR RETURN.
newsitem.headline: DELPHI FIXED INCOME FUND CLAIMS TOP 3-YR RETURN.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank's Delphi fixed income fund said it returned 100.2 percent since January 1993 to date, assuming dividend reinvestment and topped its category.
It said it outperformed an alternative investment in one-year T-bills during the same period which would have returned 91.07 percent.
Starting with assets of 200 million drachmas in August 1992, the fund has grown in size to 60 billion making it the largest fund managed by National Mortgage Mutual Funds.

Likewise, Delphi balanced fund which was launched five years ago with initial assets of one billion drachmas delivered a total return of 94 percent when the Athens benchmark share index returned only nine percent in the respective period, it said.

National Mortgage Mutual Funds launched two new funds in 1996 -- Delphi money market and Delphi international fixed income. It currently manages assets exceeding 80 billion drachmas, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
